crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Irregularly shaped, reddish-brown patch on the upper neck and posterior crown area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharply defined, high-contrast linear boundary separating the reddish-brown nape patch from the uniform grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast alternating black and white transverse bands across the tail, with a broad white band positioned at the base of the tail.
